quiz_title: Quiz on Class 58: Swamini Vato and Kirtan

questions.question_text: Swa.Vato.1/177 states: "Baḷiyā bhagwānnā bhakta hoy teno sang karīe to ____."
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/177, "Baḷiyā bhagwānnā bhakta hoy teno sang karīe to jīvmā baḷ āve."

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami states in the kirtan: "Sanmukh thātā shankā na kīje, mar ______ varase re."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 1, states, "Sanmukh thātā shankā na kīje, mar bhālā taṇā meh varase re."

questions.question_text: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan, "Hansa jaī harijanne maḷashe, pachhī ____."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 1, states, "Hansa jaī harijanne maḷashe, pachhī kāchī te kāyā paḍashe re."

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami advises: "Shūḷī upar shayan karāve toy, ______."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 2, states, "Shūḷī upar shayan karāve toy, sādhune sange rahīe re."

questions.question_text: The kirtan mentions: "Durijan lok durbhāṣhaṇ bole, tenu ____."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 2, states, "Durijan lok durbhāṣhaṇ bole, tenu sukhduḥkh sarve sahīe re."

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami's kirtan mentions that "Brahmā bhav sanakādik jevā, jenā darshan karvāne āve re". Whose darshan are they coming to have?
questions.explanation: The kirtan begins with "Mārā vā'lājī shu vā'lap dīse re..." and stanza 3 refers to "jenā darshan karvāne āve re", implying Vā'lājī.

questions.question_text: According to Muktanand Swami's kirtan, "Narakkuṇḍthī narasu lāge, ____."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 4, states, "Narakkuṇḍthī narasu lāge, durijannu mukh manmā re."

questions.question_text: Muktanand Swami, "magan thaī māge vahālā", requests: "vās dejo ______."
questions.explanation: The kirtan, stanza 4, concludes, "Muktānand magan thaī māge vahālā, vās dejo harijananmā re."

questions.question_text: Who is the author of the kirtan "Mārā vā'lājī shu vā'lap dīse re"?
questions.explanation: The kirtan is attributed to "Muktanand Swami" in the provided text's Kirtan section.

questions.question_text: What is the subject of the quote from Swa.Vato.1/177 that brings 'baḷ' to the 'jīv' when one associates with them?
questions.explanation: The quote from Swa.Vato.1/177 begins, "Baḷiyā bhagwānnā bhakta hoy teno sang karīe to..."
